name: Restaurant
description: Restaurant management: a menu with categories, modifier groups and 86-ing; floor sections and tables; a full-screen POS register with a table map, seats, split and merged checks, line and percentage discounts with reasons, comps and reopening; a kitchen display; card-present payments through Stripe Terminal plus cash with change, full and partial refunds and printable receipts; standalone customer records; and a public online-ordering storefront (menu, cart, checkout with Stripe payment or pay at pickup) that drops orders into the POS.
author: Kohevo

commercial_module.label: Restaurant
commercial_module.description: Menu, POS, tables, card readers and online ordering
